thread:
ana: Quick sync — enterprise pilot (FinSight) is pushing for two extra features before they sign: 1) per-model quantization recommendations surfaced by workload (not just global profiles), 2) eval-triggered alerts that open a ticket when quality drifts. Can we scope into the MVP or mark as post-MVP?

mike: What does "per-model" granularity mean? like per-architecture (Llama2 vs MPT) or per-model-version?

tara: Ideally per-model-version + dataset-tag. We need to surface expected quality delta from each quant profile and a confidence band.

ana: Exactly — customer wants a dropdown: "Recommend: FP16 | 4-bit | 8-bit" with an estimated BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim drop and cost delta.

mike: Implementation-wise we can compute offline on representative eval sets and store recommendations. Real-time inference could read the stored profile. Sounds doable but increases metadata surface.

zach: For eval-triggered alerts, do we have an SLI definition? Which metric triggers an alert?

tara: Proposal: primary signal = mean embedding cosine drop vs baseline on eval set; secondary = hallucination rate on a prompt set. Thresholds: 5% cosine drop OR 2x hallucination increase -> pager to eng oncall? Maybe start with an in-console alert, not a pager.

ana: Launch criteria idea: (a) UI to show per-model-version recommendation + cost/quality estimate, (b) automated job to recompute recommendations weekly, (c) alerting pipeline: console alert + Slack channel + a ticket created in Zendesk. Pager only for severe regressions (>10% cosine drop).

mike: Engineering cost estimate: core work = evaluation harness + storage schema + UI. Ballpark 3-4 sprints (2 engs) to get a safe MVP with weekly offline recompute and console alerts. Another sprint for ticket integration and Slack hook. Pager path is another sprint for runbook + SRE oncall.

ana: Customer is sensitive to sign date. If we push pager to post-MVP they might accept. We need to confirm if Zendesk ticket creation is mandatory.

tara: We should also provide guidance text: "Quant recommended only if inference latency/cost tradeoff > X and quality loss < Y" — product copy + a small decision tree.

zach: Ops ask: store computed metrics in a time-series so we can show historical drift. That adds DB storage but necessary for alerts.

mike: Yep, TS store + retention policy. Start with 90d retention for pilot.

ana: Proposed plan: ship MVP for pilot by shipping week 6 with: per-model-version recommendations (offline weekly compute), console-only eval alerts, Zendesk ticket integration. Post-MVP: pager runway, more frequent recompute, per-customer thresholds.

mike: +1. I'll break into tickets: eval harness, storage, UI, alert pipeline, zendesk hook.

tara: I'll draft the acceptance tests (example eval sets, threshold checks, documentation).

ana: Action items: mike create tickets by EOD Tue; tara upload pilot eval sets; I'll confirm with FinSight about Zendesk requirement. If all agreed we'll mark this as "MVP with pilot add-ons" in roadmap. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: optimize-toolkit/recommendation-service -> staging (build #3721)

zach: Thanks — one more: include a knob for customers to opt out of auto-ticket creation (privacy). Important for regulated ones.

ana: Good call, add opt-out flag to tickets ticket. I'll update the acceptance criteria.
